_about: Stable, verified STRUCTURAL facts about footprint banks — the figures that do NOT change week-to-week (asset size/rank, branch & ATM fleet counts, known ATM/software vendor, Printec relationship, current C-suite, recent M&A). Purpose: stop the research agents from re-deriving these from memory every run and the verify pass from re-correcting the same stale numbers (the 2026-06-24 Agent-5 run had the adversarial pass contradict 9 carried figures, most of them static structural facts). This is a CURATED reference, NOT a machine-fetched cache — a human/operator updates it after each run with any figure the verify pass corrected or freshly confirmed against a PRIMARY source.
_how_to_use: Agents (esp. Agent 5 Jobs and Agent 1 Bank-Disclosures): BEFORE asserting a structural fact (fleet size, branch/ATM count, asset rank, incumbent vendor, current CxO), read this file's entry for the bank. If your fresh research AGREES, cite the primary source and move on (don't burn budget re-deriving). If it DISAGREES, that is a real signal — report the delta with both the old (this file) and new (your source) value + date, and the operator updates this file. NEVER treat a value here as a source to cite — it is a memory of the last verified value; always re-anchor a reported figure to a live primary URL. Fields marked status:'unverified' or 'aggregator' are NOT confirmed — treat them as leads to verify, not facts.
_maintenance: After each Agent-5 / Agent-1 run, fold the verify-pass corrections into the matching entry, bump '_verified', and add the primary source URL. Keep ONLY primary/regulator/IR-sourced figures; drop anything that cannot be re-confirmed. Add new footprint banks as they surface. One source of truth shared by the collector agents — the equivalent of agent-units.json for stable facts.

_fact_status_legend.partially-confirmed: direction/order-of-magnitude right but the exact figure rests on a secondary source
_fact_status_legend.aggregator: from a third-party aggregator only — verify before relying
_fact_status_legend.unverified: internal/CRM claim or single weak source — lead, not fact
_fact_status_legend.historical: a completed past event, retained so it is not re-reported as new
